news.title: Xabi Alonso updates on Marco Palestra fitness
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索更新了马可·帕莱斯特拉的健康状况
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso is hopeful he will be able to call upon Blues defender Marco Palestra before this month's international break begins. The Italian, who arrived from Atalanta earlier this summer and impressed in our pre-season fixtures, has yet to make his competitive Chelsea debut because of an injury he sustained in the build-up to our Premier League opener at Fulham. Alonso has confirmed what the 21-year-old's issue is, and provided an update on when the full-back could return to action. ‘The injury is something on the quad,’ said Alonso. ‘He's almost in the last stages of the recovery, so we will see. If not [fit for] Brentford, then Bournemouth for sure.’ Palestra was an integral part of our summer schedule, impressing Alonso during our time in Australia and Asia, and then catching the eye on his first appearance at Stamford Bridge as we defeated Real Sociedad. That Palestra’s promising start was cut short before the real action got underway was obviously disappointing for all concerned, but Alonso has stressed the importance of the 21-year-old remaining patient. ‘He's quite frustrated after a very good pre-season not to be able to play and to make his debut in the Premier League,’ Alonso acknowledged. ‘But I told Marco, "Easy, the season is long, there will be a lot of games, and you will play your role, you will have your minutes, you will enjoy your game.” ‘He is full of energy, and you need to control that.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索希望他能够在本月的国际比赛日开始之前召唤蓝军后卫马科·帕莱斯特拉。这位意大利人今年夏天早些时候从亚特兰大加盟，在我们的季前赛中给人留下了深刻的印象，但由于他在对阵富勒姆的英超揭幕战中受伤，他还没有在切尔西的比赛中首次亮相。阿隆索已经确认了这位 21 岁球员的问题所在，并提供了这位后卫何时可以重返赛场的最新消息。 “伤病是在四轮驱动车上发生的，”阿隆索说。 “他几乎处于康复的最后阶段，所以我们拭目以待。如果不适合布伦特福德，那么肯定是伯恩茅斯。”帕莱斯特拉是我们夏季赛程中不可或缺的一部分，在澳大利亚和亚洲的比赛中给阿隆索留下了深刻的印象，然后在我们击败皇家社会队时，他在斯坦福桥的首次亮相就引起了人们的注意。帕莱斯特拉充满希望的开局在真正的行动开始之前就被缩短了，这显然让所有相关人员感到失望，但阿隆索强调了这位 21 岁的剩余病人的重要性。阿隆索承认，“在经历了一个非常出色的季前赛后，他非常沮丧，因为无法参加比赛并在英超联赛中首次亮相。” “但我告诉马可，‘轻松，赛季很长，会有很多比赛，你会扮演你的角色，你会有你的上场时间，你会享受你的比赛。’” “他精力充沛，你需要控制它。”

news.title: Alonso on Palmer and Rogers enjoying themselves and Hull respect
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈帕尔默和罗杰斯享受自己和赫尔的尊重
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso is delighted to see Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers linking up so well at Chelsea in the early stages of this season, but won’t be taking anything for granted when we host high-flying Hull City in the Premier League. Old friends Palmer and Rogers have made an excellent start to the season since being reunited at Stamford Bridge over the summer, when the latter completed a move to Chelsea from Aston Villa. So far they have contributed 11 goal involvements between them in these early stages of the campaign and Alonso’s tenure in the Blues dugout, with five of those coming in one game alone, when we defeated Leeds United 6-3 in the third round of the Carabao Cup on Wednesday evening. As we prepare to return to Premier League action by hosting Hull at the Bridge on Saturday, Alonso explained why he thinks they have linked up together so well so quickly on the pitch. ‘Both are enjoying themselves, playing in the team and with each other,’ said our manager. ‘They enjoy when one makes good things for the team. ‘We were expecting that and we’re so happy that it’s happening. It’s early days but we have a good partnership there, and with Joao [Pedro] linking with them it’s a strength that we have.’ That front three of Palmer, Rogers and Joao Pedro has certainly caught the eye in 2026/27, but face a stern challenge in our next match, when we take on a Hull team which is yet to concede a goal since their return to the Premier League. The newly-promoted side remain unbeaten and have shot up into third spot in the table - one place above the Blues - fast becoming this season’s surprise package in the top flight. That was something Alonso was quick to point out, when asked if it is becoming ‘impossible’ for opponents to keep out Chelsea’s front three. ‘Let’s not talk about those big words – and impossible in football is too big a word,’ he countered. ‘We face tomorrow’s game with the same respect as against Arsenal. Hull have seven points, no goals conceded, they will be hard to beat. They have their weapons with transitions and set -pieces, and they have the belief. ‘Their coach is doing a great job, so it’s going to be hard and we’re going to have to be at our best to beat them tomorrow. ‘They deserve to be where they are. They have played against Manchester United, Coventry and against Aston Villa, and they have done it really well. ‘They have shown they have built a very clear idea of what they want, how they want to compete, and with players already there last season and other players who have come in new. ‘They want to fight with everything to get their goal, which I guess is to stay in the Premier League, and they are doing well. Tomorrow is a chance for us to be the first to beat them in the Premier League.’ All of that means Chelsea won’t be taking Saturday’s challenge lightly, no matter how potent our attack has been in recent weeks. ‘Tomorrow we are prepared and ready, there will not be complacency from us, we have full respect for them and we know it will be hard to beat them. ‘But if we do things well, compete and play at our level, I feel we will have a good chance.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索很高兴看到科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯在本赛季初期在切尔西如此出色地配合，但当我们在英超联赛中迎战雄心勃勃的赫尔城时，他不会认为任何事情都是理所当然的。老朋友帕尔默和罗杰斯今年夏天在斯坦福桥重聚，罗杰斯从阿斯顿维拉转会到切尔西，他们在本赛季取得了良好的开局。到目前为止，他们在赛季初期和阿隆索执掌蓝军教练席期间已经贡献了 11 粒进球，其中 5 粒进球是在周三晚卡拉宝杯第三轮比赛中以 6-3 击败利兹联队的一场比赛中打进的。当我们准备周六在桥上迎战赫尔城重返英超联赛时，阿隆索解释了为什么他认为他们在球场上如此迅速地配合得如此紧密。 “两人都玩得很开心，在球队中踢球，彼此相处，”我们的经理说。 “当一个人为球队做出好事时，他们会感到高兴。 “我们期待着这一点，我们很高兴它发生了。现在还处于早期阶段，但我们在那里有良好的合作伙伴关系，若昂[佩德罗]与他们联系在一起，这是我们所拥有的优势。帕尔默、罗杰斯和若昂佩德罗组成的锋线三人无疑在2026/27赛季引起了人们的注意，但在我们的下一场比赛中将面临严峻的挑战，届时我们将对阵赫尔城队，该队自重返英超以来尚未失球。这支升班马保持不败，并在积分榜上上升到第三位——比蓝军高出一位——迅速成为本赛季顶级联赛的惊喜。当被问及对手是否“不可能”阻挡切尔西的前三名球员时，阿隆索很快指出了这一点。 “我们不要谈论那些大词——在足球界，‘不可能’这个词太大了，”他反驳道。 “我们以与对阵阿森纳时同样的尊重来面对明天的比赛。赫尔城积7分，没有丢球，他们将很难被击败。他们有过渡和定位球的武器，而且有信念。 “他们的教练做得很好，所以这会很困难，我们必须竭尽全力明天才能击败他们。 ‘他们应该呆在他们现在的位置。他们对阵曼联、考文垂和阿斯顿维拉，他们都做得非常好。 “他们已经表明，他们已经非常清楚自己想要什么，想要如何竞争，以及与上赛季已经在场的球员和其他新加盟的球员进行竞争。 `他们想尽一切努力来实现自己的目标，我想就是留在英超，他们做得很好。明天是我们在英超联赛中成为第一个击败他们的机会。”所有这一切都意味着切尔西不会掉以轻心地对待周六的挑战，无论我们最近几周的进攻有多么有力。 “明天我们已经做好了准备，我们不会自满，我们充分尊重他们，我们知道击败他们是很困难的。 “但如果我们做得好，按照我们的水平竞争和比赛，我觉得我们会有很好的机会。”

news.title: Xabi Alonso on the ‘many qualities’ of Pedro Neto
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索谈佩德罗·内托的“诸多品质”
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has explained why Pedro Neto is such an important player for the Blues on the day our No.7 signed a new contract at Chelsea. It was confirmed this afternoon, shortly after Alonso finished speaking to the media at Cobham, that Neto has committed his future to the club until 2032. The Portugal international has already shown this season how important he is to Alonso, having been deployed as a wing-back and in a more advanced role in our opening fixtures of the campaign. And our manager detailed exactly what makes Neto such an invaluable squad member, and why it is hard to pigeonhole him into a single position. ‘For me he is a winger, but you can call him a winger or a wing-back because he has many qualities,’ said Alonso. ‘He can play on the last line and he can defend in the first line; he has the capacity to do many things. He is good at one-v-ones, is scoring goals, has a fantastic work rate and connects very well with the players around him. ‘I knew him well from watching many games of Chelsea, but with him you know that he is going to compete and you want these kind of players in the team. I’m very happy with Pedro and the work he is doing.’
news.body_zh: 在我们的七号球员与切尔西签订新合同的那天，哈比·阿隆索解释了为什么佩德罗·内托是蓝军如此重要的球员。今天下午，在阿隆索在科巴姆接受媒体采访后不久，内托就将自己的未来奉献给了俱乐部，直到 2032 年。这位葡萄牙国脚已经在本赛季展现了他对阿隆索的重要性，他在本赛季的首场比赛中被安排担任边后卫并担任更靠前的角色。我们的经理详细说明了是什么让内托成为如此宝贵的队员，以及为什么很难将他归为一个位置。 “对我来说，他是一名边锋，但你可以称他为边锋或边后卫，因为他有很多品质，”阿隆索说。 “他可以在最后防线踢球，也可以在第一线防守；他有能力做很多事情。他擅长一对一，进球，工作效率很高，并且与周围的球员联系得很好。 “通过观看切尔西的很多比赛，我很了解他，但和他在一起，你知道他会参加比赛，你希望球队中有这样的球员。”我对佩德罗和他所做的工作感到非常满意。

news.title: Xabi Alonso confirms Chelsea team news for Hull City
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索确认了切尔西队为赫尔城效力的消息
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has confirmed that Moises Caicedo is not ready to return to action against Hull City tomorrow – but fellow midfielder Romeo Lavia is in contention to feature against the Tigers at Stamford Bridge. A calf injury has impacted Caicedo's start to the new campaign. The Ecuadorian midfielder missed our opening two fixtures, away at Fulham and at home to Luton Town, but was introduced as a second-half substitute in our 4-3 victory over Brighton and Hove Albion. Unfortunately, Caicedo's return lasted just 14 minutes as he suffered a recurrence of the issue that had kept him sidelined. Alonso explained ahead of our midweek game against Leeds United that Caicedo was training, but that no risks were being taken over his return, a policy that has been extended to Hull's visit tomorrow afternoon. ‘Not yet [ready to return]; let’s see for Brentford,' Alonso explained during his pre-match press conference. 'Unluckily, not yet, and it's not the moment to take the risk with him. We are not there yet.' One positive is that Alonso confirmed that Lavia, who wasn't in our matchday squad against Leeds on Wednesday evening, is ready to feature this weekend. The Blues manager also provided the latest on Jordan Henderson and Emmanuel Emegha, who have been sidelined since the start of the campaign and are yet to make their Chelsea debuts after arriving this summer. ‘Not tomorrow,' the Spaniard explained. 'We hope they can be [ready] against Brentford, but we will see.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索证实莫伊塞斯·凯塞多还没有准备好明天对阵赫尔城的比赛，但中场球员罗密欧·拉维亚有望在斯坦福桥对阵老虎队的比赛中出场。小腿受伤影响了凯塞多新赛季的开局。这位厄瓜多尔中场缺席了我们的前两场比赛，客场对阵富勒姆和主场对阵卢顿镇，但在我们4-3战胜布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩的比赛中作为下半场替补上场。不幸的是，凯塞多的回归只持续了14分钟，因为他的伤病复发，导致他缺阵。阿隆索在周中对阵利兹联的比赛前解释说，凯塞多正在训练，但他的回归不会冒任何风险，这一政策已延续到赫尔城明天下午的访问。 ‘还没有[准备返回]；让我们看看布伦特福德，”阿隆索在赛前新闻发布会上解释道。 “不幸的是，现在还没有，而且现在还不是和他一起冒险的时候。我们还没有到那里。一个积极的方面是，阿隆索确认拉维亚已经准备好在本周末出场，她没有出现在周三晚上对阵利兹联的比赛阵容中。这位蓝军主教练还提供了乔丹·亨德森和伊曼纽尔·埃梅加的最新消息，他们自赛季开始以来一直缺阵，今年夏天抵达切尔西后尚未首次亮相。 “明天不行，”西班牙人解释道。 “我们希望他们能够在对阵布伦特福德的比赛中做好准备，但我们拭目以待。”

news.title: Premier League ticket news: Tottenham at home
news.title_zh: 英超联赛门票新闻：托特纳姆热刺主场
news.body_en: Ticket selling arrangements, including details on the application window and loyalty points, have been confirmed for next month’s London derby. Our Premier League encounter with Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge kicks off at 5.30pm on Saturday 24 October. Home tickets for members for men’s team matches are now allocated through a new application process. For each home match, eligible members have a designated application window during which they can apply for tickets. Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets will be allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application. Please note: This fixture will be sold using the loyalty points accrued so far this season. The number of loyalty points required will be confirmed via this web story and the buy tickets page after the application window closes. A list of all the loyalty points that could be accrued so far this season is available at the bottom of this web story. Any supporters who do not meet the loyalty point requirement will be unsuccessful and will also not have access to the priority ticket exchange window. Ticket application window opens – Monday 14 September 12pm Ticket application window closes – Thursday 17 September 12pm The ticket application window will be open for True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue and Junior Blue members. As part of the verification process, a pre-authorisation charge £0.01 will be applied to validate your payment card. No money will be taken at this stage, and the hold will be removed by your provider. Tickets for this match are priced at Category AA. Please click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. Eligible members can submit their application through the official ticketing portal at any time during the window, supporters must ensure they are logged in to successfully apply. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them. As part of the new ticket sales process, members who are eligible for concession-rate tickets are automatically assigned their price class. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check the date of birth on your account is accurate. You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. If you only wish to be entered for tickets in one area of the stadium, please leave the second option blank. Please read the ticket application information carefully before submitting your application. Successful and unsuccessful applications will be notified by email within four working days of the ticket application window closing date. Successful applications will be charged to their payment card approximately at this time. Supporters are not able to use account credit for ticket application window purchases. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with and sit next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Members and season ticket holders can purchase Westview tickets for Premier League home games via the Chelsea FC Official Ticketing Portal. A maximum of four tickets can be bought per person, and only the ticket purchaser is required to be a member or season ticket holder. You are not required to be a member or season ticket holder to purchase non-Westview Club Chelsea packages. Club Chelsea tickets are non-refundable unless the match is cancelled, postponed, or moved more than 48 hours either side of the scheduled fixture date. All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to Club Chelsea terms and conditions. For any further Westview enquiries, please email clubchelsea@chelseafc.com. Loyalty points will now only be awarded for attendance at men’s first-team home matches and no longer accrued for purchasing tickets. Points will be added to eligible accounts following each game, provided the ticket has been scanned at the turnstile. This means that supporters purchasing tickets on the ticket exchange, or receiving tickets via ticket forwarding, will now receive loyalty points for attending matches. Supporters will receive one loyalty point for attending this match. Points will be applied after the fixture has been played. Members can still purchase general admission tickets if available in line with the General Admission Policy. Supporters who require accessible tickets can apply through the accessible ticket application window. Timings are below: Accessible ticket application window opens - Monday 14 September 12pm Accessible ticket application window closes – Thursday 17 September 12pm Supporters, if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) for any questions or if they need further information. Personal assistant tickets can be submitted during this ticket application window. Supporters can apply for car parking by clicking here from Thursday 24 September. You are required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge. In addition to season ticket holders, True Blue+, True Blue and CFC Blue members now have the option to list tickets on the ticket exchange if they are unable to attend a home match. Supporters can access the ticket exchange through the official ticketing portal. The sales information on the buy tickets pagewill be updated once the ticket exchange is open. The ticket exchange will close three hours before kick-off, unless stated otherwise. Those unsuccessful in the ticket application window, who met the loyalty points criteria for this fixture, will have a ticket exchange priority period. These supporters will be notified via email that the priority window is open. A further announcement will be made on the buy tickets page to confirm when the ticket exchange is open to all members. The all on-sale dates page available by clicking here will also be updated. Once open, season ticket holders and members can send and receive tickets up until three hours before kick-off. Please note that those who have forwarded their ticket will not be able to list their ticket on the ticket exchange. news.title: Pedro Neto picks his five best moments with Chelsea
news.title_zh: 佩德罗·内托挑选了他在切尔西的五个最佳时刻
news.body_en: After signing a new contract with Chelsea to extend his stay in west London, Pedro Neto has been reminiscing about his Blues career to date, choosing his favourite moments with the club. The Portuguese winger joined Chelsea from fellow Premier League side Wolverhampton Wanderers in the summer of 2024 and has been an important member of the squad ever since, registering 21 goals and 19 assists in 108 appearances across all competitions in his two-and-a-bit seasons at Stamford Bridge. That includes two goals in five games in 2026/27, having featured in every match under Xabi Alonso so far. After ensuring there will be many more great moments to come for Neto with the Blues in the future by putting pen to paper on a new contract, the 26-year-old looked back at his favourites from the last two years in SW6... The Arsenal goal at home, it was my first goal in the Premier League. It was a really important one as well. It felt like a breakthrough and it stayed a lot on my mind because of the lanes – I think it’s called the lanes! – when the fans hit the panels in the back of the stands. I could hear it. The noise was really unbelievable so it is something that will always stay in my mind. Plus it is a huge thing to score at Stamford Bridge against Arsenal. I will say Fulham away because of the importance of my goal in the moment that we took a big step towards qualifying for the Champions League. I will be honest, after the first half it was really difficult. The fans were not happy as well, we were losing 1-0 away, knowing that it was an important game to get into the Champions League. After Tyrique [George] scored his first goal, you could feel the mentality changed a little bit in the last minutes of the game. And then the goal that I scored was just... whew. I don’t know what to say! In that moment I just wanted to run like crazy because it was a really important goal. I knew the importance of the goal because we could get the Champions League with that goal, and the way I scored that goal as well as was top! The Conference League was my first title for Chelsea, and the most important one I had won at the time in my short career. Before I just had one trophy and to win the Conference League was huge. Plus it was a situation that we felt like if we didn’t win it people would be ready to criticise us, but we did our job and honestly it was really joyful when we won. This one is an unbelievable one! It was the first one that ever existed of this competition! I would say in the beginning, everyone would have said the importance of that competition was not that big, but when you are there you realise how important it is. You realise how difficult it is too, because you are playing against the best teams in the world. It is a competition that only happens every four years as well, so the importance of it is even bigger. When you realise you’ve won such an important competition, it’s a no-brainer that it's one of my favourite moments. It was a crazy feeling! I think the people who were there, they didn’t believe Chelsea could win it, but us as a group we always had that target in our mind and thank God we did it. The Hull hat-trick was a beautiful hat-trick, to be honest, and it was the first hat-trick of my career so I will never forget it. I keep the match ball at home in my gaming room, in front of the TV so that every time I look at the TV I have the ball in front of me too, to kind of bring back some good memories for me. It was an absolutely unbelievable moment for me.
news.body_zh: 在与切尔西签订新合同以延长他在伦敦西部的停留时间后，佩德罗·内托一直在回忆他迄今为止的蓝军生涯，选择了他在俱乐部最喜欢的时刻。这位葡萄牙边锋于2024年夏天从英超球队狼队加盟切尔西，此后一直是球队的重要成员，在斯坦福桥的两个多赛季里，他在所有比赛中出场108次，贡献21个进球和19次助攻。其中包括在 2026/27 赛季的五场比赛中打进两个进球，到目前为止，他在哈维·阿隆索的带领下参加了每场比赛。在签下新合同，确保内托未来将与蓝军一起度过更多伟大时刻后，这位26岁的球员回顾了他过去两年在SW6最喜欢的进球……阿森纳在主场的进球，这是我在英超的第一个进球。这也是一件非常重要的事情。这感觉就像是一个突破，而且因为泳道，它一直留在我的脑海里——我想这就是所谓的泳道！ – 当球迷撞击看台后面的面板时。我能听到。噪音真的令人难以置信，所以它永远留在我的脑海里。另外，在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的比赛中进球也是一件大事。我会说客场对阵富勒姆，因为在我们朝着欧冠资格迈出了一大步的那一刻，我的进球非常重要。老实说，上半场过后真的很困难。球迷们也不高兴，我们客场0-1输球，因为他们知道这是一场进入欧冠的重要比赛。在蒂里克（乔治）打进他的第一个进球后，你可以感觉到比赛最后几分钟心态发生了一些变化。然后我打进的进球就是……哇。我不知道该说什么！那一刻我只想疯狂地奔跑，因为这是一个非常重要的目标。我知道这个进球的重要性，因为我们可以凭借这个进球获得欧冠冠军，而且我进球的方式也是顶级的！分区联赛是我为切尔西赢得的第一个冠军，也是我短暂的职业生涯中赢得的最重要的一个冠军。在我只获得一座奖杯之前，赢得分区联赛的意义重大。另外，在这种情况下，我们觉得如果我们没有获胜，人们就会准备批评我们，但我们做了我们的工作，说实话，当我们获胜时真的很高兴。这是一件令人难以置信的事！这是有史以来第一次有这样的比赛！我想说，一开始，每个人都会说这场比赛的重要性不是那么大，但是当你在那里时，你就会意识到它有多么重要。你也意识到这有多困难，因为你正在与世界上最好的球队比赛。这也是四年一届的比赛，因此其重要性就更加突出了。当你意识到自己赢得了如此重要的比赛时，毫无疑问这是我最喜欢的时刻之一。那是一种疯狂的感觉！我认为那里的人不相信切尔西能够赢得冠军，但我们作为一个团队，我们始终牢记这个目标，感谢上帝，我们做到了。老实说，对阵赫尔城的帽子戏法是一个美丽的帽子戏法，这是我职业生涯的第一个帽子戏法，所以我永远不会忘记它。我把比赛用球放在家里的游戏室里，放在电视机前，这样每次我看电视时，比赛用球就在我面前，给我带来一些美好的回忆。这对我来说绝对是难以置信的时刻。

news.body_en:
Chelsea is delighted to announce that Pedro Neto has signed a new contract until 2032.
 The Portugal international arrived at Stamford Bridge two years ago and has since made 108 appearances for the Blues. In that time his tally for goals and assists is 40 for the club. Neto played a crucial part in our UEFA Conference League and FIFA Club World Cup victories in 2025, scoring three times in the latter competition as we triumphed on the global stage. This season Neto, 26, already has two goals to his name, including that brilliant strike on Wednesday which completed our rapid comeback against Leeds in the Carabao Cup. ‘It’s an unbelievable moment,’ said Neto after committing his future to the Blues. ‘From when I arrived, I have always felt like the people here helped me a lot. I feel like home here, I feel like I want to achieve more things here. ‘I have had some good moments here as a group and as an individual, and now I want to have more of those moments. I’m really excited because I think we can achieve a lot of things together.' Neto joined Chelsea from Wolves in August 2024 and quickly became an integral part of the side that lifted two pieces of silverware that season. Among many individual highlights were a superb first Premier League goal for the club, against Arsenal, and then a last-gasp winner at Craven Cottage that secured three precious points in our ultimately successful hunt for Champions League qualification. That goal against Fulham was voted by Blues fans as our best in 2024/25. Neto has been a dependable and consistent performer for the past two years, whether deployed on either flank, as a false nine, in a number ten position or as a wing-back. We look forward to the next chapters of his Chelsea journey. Congratulations on your new deal, Pedro!

news.body_en: Chelsea have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. Here, we look at which of the Blues' players are must-haves, who the best value-for-money picks are and why Joao Pedro (£7.7m) is Chelsea’s most popular player. It’s all about the Blues’ attack this week, with Chelsea scoring a whopping 16 goals in five matches under Xabi Alonso. Both Morgan Rogers (£7.6m) and Cole Palmer (£9.7m) feature in the top five most-transferred players ahead of Gameweek 4. Combined, the duo have been bought in over one million times by Fantasy managers. Morgan Rogers continued his superb start to life in a Chelsea shirt with another attacking return, this time a well-taken goal against Arsenal. The Englishman followed this up with four assists off the bench in the 6-3 victory over Leeds United on Wednesday. No Blues player has registered more expected goal involvements (xGI) or created more big chances so far this season. Rogers is yet to blank in Fantasy this season and rose in price earlier in the week, with Fantasy managers valuing his consistency. Slightly more expensive but no less popular is Cole Palmer. Chelsea’s number 10 netted twice in four minutes in the aforementioned midweek victory and looks back to his best after an injury-hit 25/26 campaign. As a result, he looks set to be one of the most-captained players in the Gameweek. A penalty in the League Cup has only strengthened his appeal, with managers valuing the apparent confirmation that he remains on spot-kick duty for this season. Palmer leads the way among his Blues team-mates for shots (12) and shots on target (5). Unsurprisingly, Joao Pedro (£7.7m) is the highest-owned Chelsea player in FPL and indeed in the entire game. The Brazilian currently sits in just under 72% of teams. Over 200,000 managers have transferred in the Brazilian ahead of Saturday’s GW4 deadline. Pedro is the third-highest-scoring forward in Fantasy, despite scoring a very unfortunate own goal against Brighton. Among Blues players, Pedro leads the way for big chances (3), penalty box touches (21) and expected goals (1.87). This continues a trend from last season when Chelsea’s number nine led the way for all three of those metrics. Plenty of managers have adopted this strategy, with it proving popular for those playing the Free Hit or Wildcard chip in Gameweek 4. While Hull City are yet to concede a goal, the underlying data suggests they have been slightly fortunate with an expected goals conceded (xGC) figure of over five. In defence, Jorrel Hato (£4.5m) started once again as the left wing-back and was rested in midweek against Leeds United. The Dutchman picked up his second assist of the season so far and has created two big chances from his more advanced position. Owned by fewer than 1% of Fantasy managers, the Dutchman is the cheapest way into the Chelsea backline and has had more penalty box touches (5) than any of his fellow Blues defenders. Hato looks to be the best Chelsea defensive asset with Hull City ranking bottom for xG so far this season. The opposite wing-back, Pedro Neto (£6.5m), has impressed on the right in recent matches, scoring the Blues’ second goal against Brighton and netting in the Carabao Cup - as well as being unfortunate to hit the post at the Emirates with a first-half effort. In Gameweek 3, no Blues player had more penalty box touches (6) than Neto. The Portugal international is one to watch as he is the cheapest Blues attacker in FPL to have started a league game so far. Cole Palmer and Joao Pedro will likely be very heavily captained this weekend. Outside of Chelsea, Alexander Isak (£9.1m) looks like a strong option for Liverpool's home match against Fulham. The Swede scored twice last time out against Ipswich and has netted three times already in 26/27. No team has conceded more big chances than Fulham, while they also rank second-worst for expected goals conceded (xGC). Expect plenty of opportunities for points for Liverpool attackers at Anfield this Saturday. As usual, Erling Haaland (£15.5m) is a key contender in the captaincy conversation. Manchester City travel to Old Trafford on Sunday, a fixture that Haaland enjoys. In seven Manchester derbies in the Premier League, the Norwegian has racked up eight goals and three assists. No player has registered more shots on target (8), big chances (5) and penalty box touches (21) so far this season than the Norwegian, who scored and claimed maximum bonus points against Coventry City in Gameweek 3.
news.body_zh: 切尔西已与 Fantasy Football Scout 合作，帮助您在 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) 赛季期间为您提供提示、技巧和建议。球探将利用他们的专业知识提供建议和比赛周技巧，这对确保您赢得迷你联赛很有用。在这里，我们来看看哪些蓝军球员是必备球员，谁是最具性价比的球员，以及为什么若奥·佩德罗（770万英镑）是切尔西最受欢迎的球员。本周蓝军的进攻是重点，切尔西在哈维·阿隆索的带领下，在五场比赛中攻入了惊人的 16 粒进球。摩根·罗杰斯（760 万英镑）和科尔·帕尔默（970 万英镑）在第四届比赛之前都位列转会最多的球员前五名。加起来，这对二人组已被 Fantasy 经理买入超过 100 万次。摩根·罗杰斯在切尔西球衣中延续了他的精彩开局，并再次发起进攻，这一次是对阵阿森纳的精彩进球。这位英国人在周三 6-3 战胜利兹联的比赛中替补出场贡献了 4 次助攻。本赛季迄今为止，没有任何蓝军球员的预期进球参与度（xGI）或创造的重大机会比他多。罗杰斯本赛季在幻想队中尚未出现空白，并在本周早些时候上涨，幻想队经理重视他的稳定性。科尔·帕尔默 (Cole Palmer) 稍贵一些，但同样受欢迎。在上述周中的胜利中，切尔西的 10 号球员在四分钟内梅开二度，在 25/26 赛季受伤病困扰后，他又回到了自己的最佳状态。因此，他看起来将成为游戏周中出场次数最多的球员之一。联赛杯中的点球只会增强他的吸引力，主教练们很看重他在本赛季继续担任点球职责的明显确认。帕尔默在射门次数（12 次）和射正次数（5 次）方面在蓝军队友中名列前茅。不出所料，若昂·佩德罗（770 万英镑）是 FPL 乃至整场比赛中身价最高的切尔西球员。巴西人目前在球队中的比例略低于 72%。在周六的第四届世界杯截止日期之前，已有超过 20 万教练转会巴西人。佩德罗是幻想队中得分第三高的前锋，尽管在对阵布莱顿的比赛中打进了一个非常不幸的乌龙球。在蓝军球员中，佩德罗在绝佳机会（3次）、禁区触球（21次）和预期进球（1.87）方面领先。这延续了上赛季的趋势，当时切尔西的九号球衣在所有这三个指标上都领先。很多主教练都采用了这一策略，事实证明，这种策略对于那些在第四场比赛中玩免费安打或通配符筹码的人来说很受欢迎。虽然赫尔城尚未失球，但基础数据表明他们有点幸运，预期失球 (xGC) 数字超过 5。后防线上，乔雷尔·哈托（Jorrel Hato，450万英镑）再次首发担任左翼卫，并在周中对阵利兹联的比赛中休息。荷兰人拿到了本赛季迄今为止的第二次助攻，并在更靠前的位置上创造了两次绝佳机会。荷兰人的拥有率不到 1% 的幻想队主教练，他是进入切尔西后防线最便宜的方式，并且比其他蓝军后卫有更多的禁区触球次数（5 次）。哈托看起来是切尔西最好的防守资产，而赫尔城本赛季迄今为止的 xG 排名垫底。对方边翼卫佩德罗·内托（Pedro Neto，650万英镑）在最近的比赛中在右路表现出色，在对阵布莱顿的比赛中攻入蓝军的第二个进球，并在卡拉宝杯中进球，但不幸的是在酋长球场的上半场射门击中门柱。在第三场比赛中，没有哪位蓝军球员比内托触球禁区次数更多（6 次）。这位葡萄牙国脚值得关注，因为他是迄今为止 FPL 联赛中首发身价最低的蓝军攻击手。科尔·帕尔默和若昂·佩德罗可能会在本周末担任队长。除了切尔西之外，亚历山大·伊萨克（910万英镑）看起来是利物浦主场对阵富勒姆的一个不错的选择。瑞典人上次对阵伊普斯维奇梅开二度，并在 26/27 的比赛中攻入三球。没有哪支球队比富勒姆丢掉更多的绝佳机会，而他们的预期失球数（xGC）也排名第二差。预计本周六利物浦前锋在安菲尔德将有很多得分机会。和往常一样，埃尔林·哈兰德（Erling Haaland，1550万英镑）是队长对话中的关键竞争者。曼城周日将前往老特拉福德，这是哈兰德喜欢的比赛。在英超联赛的七场曼彻斯特德比中，挪威人打进了八个进球和三个助攻。 本赛季迄今为止，没有哪位球员的射正次数（8次）、绝佳机会（5次）和触碰禁区（21次）多于这位挪威人，他在第三场比赛对阵考文垂城的比赛中进球并获得了最高积分。

news.title: Alyssa Thompson reflects on her first year at Chelsea
news.title_zh: 艾莉莎·汤普森回顾她在切尔西的第一年
news.body_en: Just over one year ago, Alyssa Thompson joined Chelsea on transfer deadline day, moving thousands of miles away from her home and family in Los Angeles as a 20-year-old rising star. It didn’t take long for her to settle in. The pacy winger made 33 appearances in her maiden campaign, scoring nine times and providing four assists for her team-mates. She established herself as one of the best players in the Women’s Super League and earned a place in the WSL Team of the Season. Now, 12 months on, Thompson sat down with us to discuss her evolution on and off the pitch since she made the bold move from LA. ‘I feel like I've changed a lot since I first came here,’ she said. ‘Being able to meet Nay (Naomi Girma) and Ellie (Carpenter) was really nice, and now we're so close. I was talking to them about it, saying how it's crazy that we didn't know each other a year ago! ‘So I think making those friendships and growing a lot as a person independently means I feel like I've learned a lot about myself. ‘On the pitch, I've grown a lot by just having so many amazing players around me and continuing to have confidence in myself. In all areas of my game, I've got better. It’s just by small margins, but it helps a lot, and I think being in this environment will continue to help me become the best soccer player that I can be. ‘Off the pitch, I cook now, and I didn't before. I feel like more of an adult in terms of taking care of myself and not relying so much on my parents and my family to be there for me, and I think that's all part of growing up. I cook pasta, chicken, steak, pad Thai, Greek. I just look on Instagram for recipes, and it’s really easy.’ When Thompson arrived, she explained that she made the decision to join Chelsea because of the prestige of the club. She wanted to play in the Women’s Champions League against other elite European sides. Yet that doesn’t mean that she doesn’t miss home. Still only 21, the former Angel City FC forward has learned to cope with the heartache that comes with living so far from her family. ‘I feel like being a part of Chelsea is such an honour,’ Thompson continued. ‘I knew the history before, but I feel like being in it and having to hold those values and the pressure that comes with it means it’s such a privilege to be on this team and be at this club. ‘Everyone here respects that, and being part of such a historic club was important to me. So I think it’s great to learn more about the history and to be around the people that helped build it up. It’s also great to be among the new people that are continuing to push the values that Chelsea has always been built on. ‘Being able to go back for international breaks helps, but I think when I first got here, I was super homesick, just because of how different it was. Coming back here for my second season, I was really excited to have a new mindset and just embrace it more. It was helpful that it was really sunny and hot when I came back; I didn't know England got like that!’ No sooner had the players arrived back at Cobham after their summer break than they were jetting off across the world to connect with our fanbase over in Australia and New Zealand. Thompson explains why that trip was so valuable in terms of team bonding, and gave details of the side's ambitions in the new campaign, which will resume when we take on Manchester United away from home in the WSL on Sunday. ‘To have a full pre-season with the team and not feel like the newest person was really nice,’ she said. ‘I feel like it was fun being able to be with the team and be somewhere different. ‘It was really far, but I think as a team we got a lot closer and being able to have fun together and laugh, just not take everything so seriously before the season got going properly, was really nice. And Ellie showed us around Australia and New Zealand, too! ‘I think as a team we want to be super ambitious this year, and we want to win more than we did last year. Everyone's coming into the season hungry, and for myself, I want to help the team in any way I can. Hopefully that means scoring goals and assisting and being a part of helping the team have success.’ The Blues played our first match at Stamford Bridge since making it our permanent home for league fixtures last Saturday. The 1-1 draw with Aston Villa took place in front of a passionate crowd, and Thompson explained the extra motivation the squad will take from that kind of atmosphere as the season progresses. ‘I feel like the crowd was really good at the game, and I think it helps playing at Stamford Bridge,' Thompson concluded. 'It’s such an amazing stadium, and I love playing there. Having the fans cheer us on, and for it to be our home now, is really amazing, and it's super fun to play there. ‘And whenever the fans come, you feel that extra love, and you want to play your best for them.’ Don't miss out on Alyssa's next match at Stamford Bridge when we take on Birmingham on 19 September! Get your tickets now...
news.body_zh: 就在一年多前，阿丽莎·汤普森 (Alyssa Thompson) 在转会截止日期那天加盟切尔西，作为一名 20 岁的后起之秀，离开洛杉矶的家和家人数千英里。没过多久，她就适应了。这位速度很快的边锋在她的处女秀中出场 33 次，攻入 9 球，并为队友提供 4 次助攻。她使自己成为女子超级联赛中最好的球员之一，并在 WSL 赛季最佳阵容中占有一席之地。现在，12 个月过去了，汤普森与我们坐下来讨论了自从她从洛杉矶大胆转会以来她在球场内外的演变。 “我觉得自从我第一次来到这里以来我已经改变了很多，”她说。 “能够见到奈（娜奥米·吉尔玛饰）和埃莉（卡彭特饰）真是太好了，现在我们已经很接近了。我和他们谈论这件事，说我们一年前还不认识，这真是太疯狂了！ “所以我认为建立这些友谊并作为一个独立的人成长很多意味着我觉得我对自己有了很多了解。 “在球场上，我身边有这么多出色的球员，并且继续对自己充满信心，所以我成长了很多。在我比赛的各个方面，我都变得更好了。虽然差距很小，但很有帮助，我认为在这种环境中将继续帮助我成为最好的足球运动员。 “在场外，我现在做饭，而以前我不做饭。我觉得自己更像一个成年人了，能够照顾自己，不再那么依赖父母和家人的支持，我认为这就是成长的一部分。我煮意大利面、鸡肉、牛排、泰式炒河粉、希腊菜。我只是在 Instagram 上查找菜谱，这真的很简单。”汤普森抵达后，她解释说，她决定加入切尔西是因为俱乐部的声望。她想在女子冠军联赛中与其他欧洲精英球队比赛。但这并不意味着她不想家。年仅 21 岁的这位前天使城足球俱乐部前锋已经学会了如何应对远离家人的生活所带来的心痛。 “我觉得成为切尔西的一员是一种荣幸，”汤普森继续说道。 “我以前了解这段历史，但我感觉自己身处其中，必须坚守这些价值观，而随之而来的压力意味着能够加入这支球队和俱乐部是一种荣幸。” “这里的每个人都尊重这一点，成为这样一个历史悠久的俱乐部的一部分对我来说很重要。因此，我认为能够更多地了解历史并与帮助建立历史的人们在一起是很棒的。能够成为继续推动切尔西一直以来所建立的价值观的新人之一，也是一件很棒的事情。 “能够回去参加国际比赛很有帮助，但我想当我第一次来到这里时，我非常想家，只是因为它有多么不同。回到这里开始我的第二个赛季，我真的很高兴能够拥有一种新的心态并更加拥抱它。当我回来时，天气真的很晴朗，很热，这对我很有帮助。我不知道英格兰会变成这样！”球员们在暑假结束后回到科巴姆，就立即飞往世界各地与澳大利亚和新西兰的球迷联系。汤普森解释了为什么这次旅行对于加强球队凝聚力而言如此有价值，并详细介绍了球队在新赛季的雄心壮志，新赛季将在周日我们客场对阵曼联的 WSL 比赛中恢复。 “能够和球队一起度过一个完整的季前赛，并且不觉得自己是最新的人，这真的很好，”她说。 “我觉得能够和球队在一起并去不同的地方很有趣。 “距离确实很远，但我认为作为一个团队，我们离得更近了，能够一起玩得开心，开怀大笑，在赛季正常进行之前不用那么认真地对待一切，真的很好。”艾莉还带我们参观了澳大利亚和新西兰！ “我认为作为一支球队，我们今年希望变得非常雄心勃勃，我们希望赢得比去年更多的胜利。每个人都渴望进入这个赛季，对于我自己来说，我想尽我所能帮助球队。希望这意味着进球和助攻，并成为帮助球队取得成功的一部分。”蓝军上周六将斯坦福桥作为我们永久的联赛主场后，在斯坦福桥进行了我们的第一场比赛。与阿斯顿维拉 1-1 战平的比赛是在热情的观众面前进行的，汤普森解释说，随着赛季的进行，球队将从这种氛围中获得额外的动力。 汤普森总结道：“我觉得观众们对这场比赛真的很感兴趣，我认为这对在斯坦福桥比赛很有帮助。” “这是一个非常棒的体育场，我喜欢在那里踢球。有球迷为我们加油，现在这里成为我们的家，真是太棒了，在那里比赛非常有趣。 “每当球迷到来时，你都会感受到额外的爱，你会想为他们发挥出最好的水平。”不要错过阿丽莎在斯坦福桥的下一场比赛，我们将于 9 月 19 日迎战伯明翰！立即获取门票...

news.title: Joao Pedro wins Premier League award

news.body_en: Joao Pedro has been named the EA Sports Premier League Player of the Month for August 2026. It is the first time Joao Pedro has received the Premier League Player of the Month award and he becomes the first Chelsea player to win it in almost two years, since Cole Palmer got his second in September 2024. Palmer was nominated again this time around but Joao Pedro finished ahead of his Blues team-mate and six other shortlisted players in the public vote to take home the prize. That comes after a flying start to the 2026/27 season for our Brazilian striker, as he registered four goal contributions in our opening two matches of our Premier League campaign, helping us to claim victory in both of them. That began when he started the scoring just 33 seconds into our opening game at Fulham, before setting up Palmer's winning goal later in that match. It was the same story in our first home game of the season against Brighton & Hove Albion, when Joao Pedro found the net with a tidy finish before teeing up Cole for the decisive goal. Those performances convinced fans around the world to cast their vote for Joao Pedro as a deserving winner of the August Premier League Player of the Month award.
news.body_zh: 若昂·佩德罗被评为 EA Sports 英超 2026 年 8 月最佳球员。这是若昂·佩德罗首次获得英超月度最佳球员奖，他成为自科尔·帕尔默于 2024 年 9 月获得第二个该奖项以来，近两年来首位获此殊荣的切尔西球员。帕尔默这次再次获得提名，但若昂·佩德罗在公众投票中领先于他的蓝军队友和其他六名入围球员，获得该奖项。在此之前，我们的巴西前锋在 2026/27 赛季取得了良好的开局，他在英超联赛的前两场比赛中贡献了四个进球，帮助我们在这两场比赛中取得了胜利。这一切始于我们对阵富勒姆的首场比赛仅 33 秒时，他就开始进球，随后又助攻帕尔默打入制胜一球。在我们本赛季第一场主场对阵布莱顿的比赛中，情况也是如此，若奥·佩德罗漂亮地破门，然后为科尔打进决定性的进球。这些表现说服了世界各地的球迷将票投给若奥·佩德罗，让他当之无愧地获得八月份英超联赛月度最佳球员奖。

news.title: Chelsea vs Hull: Key statistics and facts
news.title_zh: 切尔西 vs 赫尔城：关键统计数据和事实
news.body_en: The Blues go into our fourth Premier League match of the season in fourth place in the table, three points behind the two sides with 100 per cent records and one behind Saturday’s opponents Hull City, who have won two and drawn one of their matches. Chelsea meet Hull City for the 50th time in all competitions, needing three more goals to reach 100 against the Tigers, who were the first-ever competitive visitors to Stamford Bridge in 1905, when they were beaten 5-1. The sides last met in February, when Chelsea won 4-0 at the MKM Stadium in the FA Cup fourth round. Pedro Neto got a hat-trick and Estevao Willian scored our other goals. The last time Hull were in the Premier League in 2016/17, both league fixtures ended in 2-0 wins for the Londoners, Diego Costa netting in both. Chelsea have won our past nine matches against Hull City in all competitions and are unbeaten in 17 (15 wins, two draws) since the Tigers’ last victory, 3-0 at Boothferry Park in the old Second Division in October 1988. That remains Hull’s only win against Chelsea in the last 36 meetings over more than a century. Chelsea are unbeaten in all 10 Premier League meetings with Hull, having only faced Portsmouth more often in the competition without losing (14). The Blues are undefeated at Stamford Bridge against the Tigers in 23 matches in all competitions. Hull’s four victories against us have all been at their former grounds Anlaby Road (1906, 1911, 1925) and Boothferry Park (1988). Chelsea are aiming to win three straight Premier League games at Stamford Bridge for the first time since the final three home matches of the 2024/25 campaign, and to win our opening two home league games of a season for the first time since 2021/22. news.body_en: Supporters intending to travel to or from Saturday’s home Premier League game against Hull City using the London Underground are advised that planned engineering works may affect your journey. The District Line is closed west of Tower Hill Station and on the whole of the Edgware Road branch, including the line down to Wimbledon. This means for the match at Stamford Bridge, Fulham Broadway Station is closed all day and there are no District Line trains running to any nearby stations on that branch of the tube network. The Circle Line is also affected and is closed between Edgware Road and Aldgate (via Victoria). More information is here Please see below for a map of walking routes to and from South Kensington, Earl’s Court and Hammersmith stations from where alternative Underground lines can be used. news.title: Five key talking points from Sonia Bompastor's pre-Man Utd press conference
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托在曼联赛前新闻发布会上的五个关键话题
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor faced the media at Cobham ahead of our second Women's Super League match of the season against Manchester United on Sunday. Here are the key takeaways from our head coach's press conference... Bompastor confirmed Melvine Malard will not be fit enough to face her former club, while Mayra Ramirez and Manaka Matsukubo remain out. A late decision will be taken on Nathalie Bjorn, who is expected to travel with the squad to the North-West. Both sides go into the game off the back of disappointing results. The Blues were held to a 1-1 draw by Aston Villa at Stamford Bridge despite dominating the contest and creating plenty of good chances. Man United, meanwhile, were beaten 2-1 at London City Lionesses. As well as looking ahead to this weekend's game and how her side will respond, Bompastor reacted to the Ballon d’Or awards, including the news Hannah Hampton could retain her Yashin Trophy. Here is a summary of the best moments from Bompastor’s media conference… ‘She's a big asset, for sure. She's been playing well. My first season, she was unbelievable. We struggled a little bit more as a team last season, and we conceded more goals, but she’s one of the best in the world. I have already said that a lot. ‘The way we want to play, she's a big asset, with the quality she has as a goalkeeper in possession, out of possession. So I'm really happy to have her in my squad.’ ‘I'm pleased with the answer from the players on the pitch. I'm not concerned about how good we are training. I think the intensity, the desire, the mindset is there in terms of working hard, trying hard. We need to reflect and be honest with each other in terms of what we are missing right now, but also not being too hard on ourselves. ‘We need to find the balance between playing beautiful football and having control in most of the games, but also trying to find a way to put the ball in the net and score some goals.’ ‘We need to keep the confidence and keep working hard. I spoke after the Villa game about the mentality, the mindset. It's a huge part of being ruthless in the box. That game could have been easily 3-0 half-time, and we need to have that mentality when we have the opportunities to kill the game after 45 minutes to do that. ‘This week I was coaching the players in the final details: around timings of the runs in the box, being in the right zones, what type of crosses do we want to deliver, what are the connections between the crosser and the players who are making the runs in the box. ‘It’s just for me to reinforce those messages, to coach them on the pitch, and make sure we get them right on the game on the weekend.’ ‘No. My view is more to say it's always a difficult ground to travel to and to play at Man United, with the fans being hostile. They have a really good team. ‘They lost on the weekend, so I think they will come into this game with the desire to win the game. They are playing at home so yeah, it will be a difficult game for us again.’ ‘That's one of the options I have right now. We played LJ a lot in that position last season because we had a lot of injuries there. She helped the team a lot playing that position. ‘When you talk about LJ, she'll bring the creativity on the pitch. She was the one who was able to score the goal on the weekend. She created a lot of opportunities. ‘My job is to make sure she's performing at her best level but also, to find ways for us as a team to be able to create many situations with her and, sometimes, without her. It's difficult to only rely on one player, and we are more predictable if we rely everything on one player. But when she's at her best, I think she's one of the best players in the world.’
news.body_zh: 周日，索尼娅·邦帕斯托在本赛季第二场女足超级联赛对阵曼联的比赛前在科巴姆接受了媒体采访。以下是我们主教练新闻发布会的主要内容……邦帕斯特确认梅尔文·马拉德的健康状况不足以面对她的前俱乐部，而梅拉·拉米雷斯和马纳卡·松久保则仍缺席。纳塔莉·比约恩将在晚些时候做出决定，她预计将随队前往西北地区。双方都带着令人失望的结果进入了比赛。尽管蓝军占据了比赛的主导地位并创造了大量的好机会，但他们在斯坦福桥还是被阿斯顿维拉1-1逼平。与此同时，曼联以 2-1 击败伦敦城狮队。除了展望本周末的比赛以及她的球队将如何应对之外，邦帕斯特还对金球奖做出了反应，包括汉娜·汉普顿可能保留她的雅辛奖杯的消息。以下是 Bompastor 媒体发布会上最精彩时刻的总结……“毫无疑问，她是一笔巨大的财富。”她打得很好。我的第一个赛季，她令人难以置信。上赛季我们作为一个团队表现得更加挣扎，我们丢了更多的球，但她是世界上最好的球员之一。我已经说过很多了。 “按照我们想要的比赛方式，她是一笔巨大的财富，她拥有作为控球和失球守门员的能力。所以我真的很高兴她能加入我的球队。” “我对球场上球员的回答感到满意。我并不关心我们的训练有多好。我认为强度、渴望和心态就在于努力工作、努力尝试。我们需要反思并诚实地面对我们现在所缺少的东西，但也不要对自己太苛刻。 “我们需要在踢出漂亮的足球和在大多数比赛中保持控制之间找到平衡，但也要努力找到一种将球送入球网并取得一些进球的方法。”“我们需要保持信心并继续努力。”在对阵维拉的比赛后，我谈到了心态、心态。这是禁区内残酷的一个重要部分。那场比赛半场本来可以轻松3-0，当我们有机会在45分钟后杀死比赛时，我们需要有这样的心态。 “本周我正在指导球员们最后的细节：禁区内跑动的时间、处于正确的区域、我们想要传出什么类型的传中、传中者和禁区内跑动的球员之间的联系是什么。” “我只是要强化这些信息，在球场上指导他们，并确保我们在周末的比赛中正确对待他们。”我的观点更多的是说，去曼联踢球总是很困难，球迷们也充满敌意。他们有一支非常好的团队。 “他们在周末输了，所以我认为他们会带着赢得比赛的渴望进入这场比赛。 “他们在主场比赛，所以是的，这对我们来说又将是一场艰难的比赛。” “这是我现在的选择之一。上赛季我们在这个位置上经常扮演LJ，因为我们那里有很多伤病。她在这个位置上给球队带来了很多帮助。 “当你谈论 LJ 时，她会在球场上带来创造力。她是周末能够进球的人。她创造了很多机会。 “我的工作是确保她发挥出最佳水平，同时也要找到方法，让我们作为一个团队能够与她一起创造很多情况，有时甚至在没有她的情况下创造很多情况。”只依赖一名球员是很困难的，如果我们一切都依赖一名球员，我们会更容易预测。但当她处于最佳状态时，我认为她是世界上最好的球员之一。”

news.title: Bompastor issues Melvine Malard injury update plus news on trio

news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has confirmed Melvine Malard will not be fit to face her former club Manchester United this weekend. The attacker picked up a knock in training last week, missing the 1-1 draw with Aston Villa that got our WSL season up and running. And Bompastor has confirmed Sunday’s trip to the North-West will come too soon for the French international. ‘Unfortunately she won’t be able to return to Man United and play the game,’ said Bompastor. ‘She’s close to returning, but probably next weekend.’ Mayra Ramirez, Manaka Matsukubo and Nathalie Bjorn also missed our opening league fixture, and Bompastor provided the latest on that trio, with the most positive news regarding the Swedish defender. ‘All of them won’t be available to play this game,’ said Bompastor. ‘Nat Bjorn is starting to train fully with the team so she will be travelling with us. We will see if she has minutes or not.’ Despite their injuries, it was an exciting week for Matsukubo and Malard, both of whom were nominated for the Ballon d’Or award. Bompastor was thrilled about that achievement and can’t wait to welcome them both back to the pitch. ‘It’s a good look on us in terms of the transfer window this summer! I’m proud of them. It’s really good to be nominees in this list. The Ballon d’Or recognisation is huge in the women’s game. ‘We celebrated them for those nominations. Two of them are new signings, for now they are not on the pitch but when they join the team it will be a big help for us.’

news.title: Those Were the Days matchday heritage event to celebrate 60 years of The Shed
news.title_zh: 那些日子是庆祝 The Shed 成立 60 周年的比赛日遗产活动
news.body_en: Earlier this week, exactly 60 years had passed since a suggestion that would change Stamford Bridge forever. That moment and the impact on Chelsea’s support that followed are being celebrated at a fan-led gathering at this weekend match versus Hull City. It was in September 1966 that a letter was published in the match programme for a home game against Leicester City. A supporter called Clifford Webb penned the note with the idea to refer to the Fulham Road end of Stamford Bridge as The Shed. It also called for more people to join ‘the fanatics’ there in singing and chanting and the rest, as they say, is history. The name was adopted and it has remained in place ever since, even after the stand was rebuilt in the Nineties. To mark the anniversary, the Chelsea Heritage Partnership (a group within the Chelsea Supporters’ Trust which researches, records and shares our history) has worked with supporters old and new, along with some ex-players, to gather their memories of The Shed, both in video and written form. Plenty of these will be displayed at the special pre-match Those Were the Days heritage event in the Tea Bar, which takes place this Saturday, prior to our Premier League fixture, from 1pm. Fans are invited to come along to the event, which is free for all home match ticket holders on the day, where you can: Read about how The Shed was named and the characters involved in the movement Learn how it was transformed throughout the history of Stamford Bridge Hear first-hand recollections of supporters’ experiences of The Shed Watch clips of iconic matches, moments and goals that lit up The Shed See some of the shirts from the Chelsea Museum worn by Shed heroes from the 1960s onwards Chat with the people who were there and get a sense of what the old Shed was like The matchday programme for the Hull game will also include a special feature on The Shed so make sure you pick up a copy on the day.
news.body_zh: 本周早些时候，距离永远改变斯坦福桥的建议已经过去了整整 60 年。在本周末对阵赫尔城的比赛中，球迷们聚集在一起庆祝那一刻以及随后对切尔西支持的影响。 1966年9月，在主场对阵莱斯特城的比赛节目中发表了一封信。一位名叫克利福德·韦伯 (Clifford Webb) 的支持者写下了这张便条，将斯坦福桥的富勒姆路一端称为“The Shed”。它还呼吁更多的人加入那里的“狂热分子”，唱歌和喊口号，剩下的，正如他们所说，已经成为历史了。这个名称被采用并一直保留至今，甚至在九十年代重建看台后也是如此。为了纪念这一周年，切尔西遗产合作组织（切尔西支持者信托基金内的一个组织，研究、记录和分享我们的历史）与新老支持者以及一些前球员合作，以视频和书面形式收集他们对 The Shed 的记忆。其中大量物品将在茶吧举行的特别赛前传统活动中展示，该活动将于本周六下午 1 点在我们的英超联赛比赛之前举行。球迷受邀参加当天所有主场比赛门票持有者免费参加的活动，您可以： 了解 The Shed 的命名方式以及参与该运动的人物 了解它在斯坦福桥历史上的转变 聆听支持者对 The Shed 经历的第一手回忆 观看照亮 The Shed 的标志性比赛、时刻和进球的片段 观看来自 20 世纪 60 年代以来 Shed 英雄穿过的切尔西博物馆的一些球衣 与赫尔城比赛的比赛日节目还将包括有关 The Shed 的特别报道，因此请务必在当天领取一份。

news.title: Analysis: How devastating Palmer and Rogers helped turn tie around
news.title_zh: 分析：毁灭性的帕尔默和罗杰斯如何帮助扭转局面
news.body_en: Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers have started the season in superb form and the duo combined again to great effect on Wednesday night as we roared back from two goals down to beat Leeds United in the Carabao Cup. Palmer and Rogers were two of four fresh faces introduced by Xabi Alonso at half-time – alongside Reece James and Pedro Neto – with the Blues behind and 45 minutes from being eliminated from the competition. The changes didn’t work immediately as the visitors doubled their advantage early in the second period – but then came the fight-back. Palmer swept home a penalty and just 129 seconds later drew us level with a cute strike from the edge of the box. They were two of five shots Palmer had in the second half, with three struck from inside the box and both that hit the target finding the net. They were Chelsea-high or joint-high game figures, along with the five touches in the opposition box Palmer had as he imposed himself on the contest in devastating fashion. Our No10 was ably assisted by his great mate Rogers, who was voted Player of the Match by Blues fans. The official statistics show Rogers registered three assists, but it’s hard to argue he didn’t also set up our fifth goal, scored by Valentin Barco. The only reason Rogers’ dangerous cross that reached the Argentinean at the back post doesn’t count as an assist is because the Leeds goalkeeper Michael Zetterer got the feintest touch on it. Harsh! Rogers created Danny Welbeck’s first of the evening with a delivery from a similar area, while his clever chested assist for Palmer’s second showcased his guile. The prodded pass that found Neto for his goal was a display of bravery as a Leeds defender closed in to challenge. In total, Palmer created two chances and Rogers four, while the duo also led the way for us in terms of passes played in the final third - 16 from Rogers and 12 from Palmer. The nine passes they exchanged between one another was the most of any attacking combination on the pitch. It is already starting to feel like a telepathic understanding. We were ruthlessly efficient in the second half, scoring with each of our six shots on target. The precision of our finishing is highlighted by the fact our xG (expected goals tally) after the break was 2.09 (in contrast to 0.31 before it). In total we had 11 shots in the second 45 minutes and created five big chances. While we had less possession and completed fewer passes in the second half than we did in the first, when we had the ball, we did more with it. We pinned Leeds back, completing 20 more passes in the final third, taking twice as many touches in the opposition box and playing double the number of passes into Leeds’ defensive third. Our attacking intent created a swell of momentum that proved too hot for Leeds to handle and culminated in a thrilling come-back victory that will live long in the memory.
news.body_zh: 科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯以出色的状态开始了本赛季，周三晚上，两人再次联手发挥了巨大作用，我们在卡拉宝杯中从两球落后的情况下奋起反击，击败了利兹联。帕尔默和罗杰斯是哈维·阿隆索在中场休息时引进的四名新面孔中的两名——另外两名是里斯·詹姆斯和佩德罗·内托——蓝军落后，距离被淘汰还有 45 分钟。这些改变并没有立即发挥作用，客队在第二节初期将优势扩大了一倍，但随后出现了反击。帕尔默主罚点球，仅仅 129 秒后，他在禁区边缘的漂亮射门将我们扳平。这是帕尔默下半场五次射门中的两次，其中三次是从禁区内射门，两次都击中目标入网。他们是切尔西最高或并列最高的比赛数据，还有帕尔默在对手禁区内的五次触球，他以毁灭性的方式将自己强加在比赛中。我们的 10 号球员得到了他伟大队友罗杰斯的出色帮助，罗杰斯被蓝军球迷评选为本场比赛最佳球员。官方统计数据显示罗杰斯贡献了 3 次助攻，但很难说他没有助攻瓦伦丁·巴科 (Valentin Barco) 打进的第五个进球。罗杰斯的危险传中到达阿根廷人后门柱的位置，唯一不能算作助攻的原因是利兹联门将迈克尔·泽特勒的触球动作非常虚弱。残酷的！罗杰斯在同一区域为丹尼·维尔贝克创造了当晚的第一个进球，而他在帕尔默的第二个进球中巧妙的胸部助攻则展示了他的狡猾。当利兹后卫逼近挑战时，内托的传球展现了勇敢的表现。总的来说，帕尔默创造了两次机会，罗杰斯创造了四次机会，而这两人在最后三分之一的传球方面也领先于我们——罗杰斯有 16 次传球，帕尔默有 12 次传球。他们互相交换的九次传球是球场上所有进攻组合中最多的。它已经开始让人感觉像是一种心灵感应的理解。下半场我们的效率非常高，六次射门均命中目标。中场休息后我们的 xG（预期进球数）为 2.09（相比之下之前为 0.31），这一事实凸显了我们射门的精确度。我们在接下来的 45 分钟内总共射门 11 次，创造了 5 次绝佳机会。虽然我们下半场的控球率和传球次数都比上半场少，但当我们控球时，我们的用球次数却更多了。我们压制了利兹联，在最后三区完成了 20 次传球，在对方禁区触球次数是两倍，进入利兹队防守三区的传球次数也是两倍。我们的进攻意图创造了一股强大的势头，事实证明利兹联队无法应对，最终以一场激动人心的逆转胜利告终，这将永远留在人们的记忆中。

news.title: Neto says free-scoring Blues playing with a smile
news.title_zh: 内托说自由得分的蓝军微笑着踢球
news.body_en: Pedro Neto believes Chelsea’s six-goal haul against Leeds United was a natural result of the attacking talent the team possesses and the ‘joyful’ way the Blues are playing under Xabi Alonso. A breathless evening of knockout football at Stamford Bridge saw Chelsea fight back from two goals down in the second half to win 6-3 and book our place in the fourth round of the Carabao Cup. Neto more than played his part. He was one of four players brought on by Alonso during the break to help turn things around, and scored our third goal to give us the lead for the first time with a composed finish after Morgan Rogers had beaten the Leeds defence to the ball and played in his team-mate. ‘Morgan did a really good effort, and me, I just thought to put the ball the other way that it was coming, as I thought the goalkeeper was already coming to the other side,’ explained Neto. ‘I think Morgan did the most difficult part, then I just had to put the ball in the goal, to be honest.’ That was just one moment of an incredible 90 minutes of action, with the Portuguese international reflecting on what changed ahead of our second-half fightback. ‘It's a little bit crazy,’ he admitted. ‘I don't like to concede that many goals, but we are working on that. Of course, we like to score six goals, but to concede three is not a thing that we want to do in a lot of games, but we’re happy for the win. ‘I think in the first half they caused a lot of trouble because they are a physical team, they are really intense. At half-time, the manager spoke about that, that we needed fresh legs, fresh mentality, we needed to be more aggressive. ‘We started the second half conceding the second one, but I think it was a really good test for us. We kept calm and then, with the players that we had and the way we played, it was really good. We scored six goals, got through and we’re already looking forward to the next one.’ The 6-3 win was another example of the potent attacking threat the Blues have demonstrated under Alonso’s leadership, with a total of 16 goals scored already across our five fixtures so far in 2026/27. Needless to say, players like Neto are enjoying themselves on the pitch and feeling full of confidence. ‘I promise we will continue to try to score this amount of goals in a game. It will be very good, to be honest,’ Neto added. ‘It's been really joyful. With the guys that we have on the pitch, with the guys that come on in the game, I think the group is in a top mentality. Everyone wants to help, everyone wants to enjoy. ‘I think we learned a little bit from what happened last season. The boss brought a little bit of freshness in that level and, as you can see, everyone is playing with a smile on their face. Even in difficult situations, we think we can turn it around with the quality of the players that we have. ‘The mentality of the club is to win in every competition that we are in. So we want to compete until the last game in the Premier League. We want to go to the final to win the Carabao Cup and in the FA Cup the same. I think this should be the mentality of the team.’
news.body_zh: 佩德罗·内托认为，切尔西对阵利兹联的六粒进球是球队拥有的进攻天赋以及蓝军在哈维·阿隆索麾下“快乐”的比赛方式的自然结果。在斯坦福桥度过了一个令人窒息的淘汰赛之夜，切尔西在下半场落后两球的情况下奋起反击，最终以 6-3 获胜，锁定了卡拉宝杯第四轮的席位。内托不仅发挥了自己的作用。他是阿隆索在中场休息时派上的四名球员之一，帮助球队扭转局面，在摩根·罗杰斯突破利兹联防守并让他的队友接球后，他打进了我们的第三个进球，以沉着的射门帮助我们首次取得领先。 “摩根做得非常好，而我，我只是想把球传到球来的另一个方向，因为我认为守门员已经到了另一边，”内托解释道。 “我认为摩根做了最困难的部分，说实话，然后我只需将球射入球门。”这只是令人难以置信的 90 分钟比赛中的一个时刻，葡萄牙国脚反思了我们下半场反击之前发生的变化。 “这有点疯狂，”他承认。 “我不喜欢丢那么多球，但我们正在努力。当然，我们希望进六个球，但丢三个球并不是我们在很多比赛中想要做的事情，但我们为胜利感到高兴。 “我认为上半场他们制造了很多麻烦，因为他们是一支体力充沛的球队，他们真的很激烈。中场休息时，主教练谈到了这一点，我们需要新鲜的双腿，新鲜的心态，我们需要更具侵略性。 “我们下半场一开始就丢了第二球，但我认为这对我们来说是一次很好的考验。我们保持冷静，然后，凭借我们拥有的球员和我们的比赛方式，这真的很棒。我们打进了 6 个进球，晋级了，我们已经开始期待下一个进球了。6-3 的胜利是蓝军在阿隆索的领导下展现出的强大进攻威胁的另一个例子，2026/27 赛季迄今为止的 5 场比赛中，我们已经总共打进了 16 个进球。不用说，像内托这样的球员在球场上很享受，并且充满了自信。 “我保证我们将继续努力在一场比赛中取得如此多的进球。老实说，这将非常好，”内托补充道。 ‘这真是太高兴了。对于我们在球场上的球员，以及在比赛中登场的球员，我认为球队处于顶级的心态。每个人都想帮忙，每个人都想享受。 “我认为我们从上赛季发生的事情中学到了一些东西。老板给这个关卡带来了一点新鲜感，正如你所看到的，每个人都面带微笑地玩着。即使在困难的情况下，我们也认为我们可以凭借我们拥有的球员的素质来扭转局面。 “俱乐部的心态是在我们参加的每场比赛中获胜。所以我们希望竞争到英超联赛的最后一场比赛。我们希望进入决赛并赢得卡拉宝杯和足总杯的冠军。我认为这应该是团队的心态。

news.title: Manchester United vs Chelsea Women: How to watch, kick-off time, live stream info
news.title_zh: 曼联 vs 切尔西女足：如何观看、开球时间、直播信息
news.body_en: Chelsea Women travel north to face Manchester United in the Women's Super League in the Sunday lunchtime kick-off in our first away match of the domestic campaign. We will look to build on the point earned against Aston Villa at Stamford Bridge last weekend in our next WSL fixture. This term will see us compete in an expanded league of 14 teams, while our participation in Europe means we will not be competing in the Women's League Cup in 2026/27. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Manchester United against Chelsea Women, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. If you can't make it up to Manchester, then you can watch the match live on Sky One, Sky Sports Mix and Sky Sports+. The Blues go into the match unbeaten this season, winning back-to-back games against Real Sociedad in our Women's Champions League qualifying third round tie by an aggregate score of 6-2, and earning a 1-1 draw against Aston Villa in the WSL last weekend. news.body_zh: 切尔西女足将北上，在周日午餐时间的女足超级联赛开球中迎战曼联，这是我们国内联赛的第一场客场比赛。我们希望在下一场 WSL 比赛中，以上周末在斯坦福桥对阵阿斯顿维拉的积分为基础。本赛季我们将参加由 14 支球队组成的扩大联赛，而我们参加欧洲比赛意味着我们将不会参加 2026/27 赛季的女足联赛杯。以下是您需要了解的有关如何观看曼联对阵切尔西女足的所有信息，包括开球时间以及如何关注切尔西官方频道的比赛。切尔西女足对阵曼联的比赛将于 2026 年 9 月 13 日星期日在 Progress With Unity 体育场举行，开球时间定于英国时间中午 12 点。如果您无法前往曼彻斯特，则可以在 Sky One、Sky Sports Mix 和 Sky Sports+ 上观看比赛直播。与往常一样，球队新闻、实时更新和比赛报道将在切尔西官方应用程序和切尔西网站上的曼联对阵切尔西女子比赛中心提供。您还可以通过 X、Facebook、Instagram 和 TikTok 上的 Chelsea Women 社交媒体渠道进行关注。蓝军本赛季保持不败，在女足冠军联赛资格赛第三轮比赛中以总比分6-2连续战胜皇家社会队，并在上周末的女足联赛中1-1战平阿斯顿维拉。与此同时，曼联在赛季首场比赛中客场1-2输给了伦敦城狮队。红军在夏天更换了主教练，与五年后的马克·斯金纳分道扬镳，并从苏格兰中洛锡安女子之心引进了伊娃·奥利德。切尔西在过去六场对阵红魔的比赛中赢了五场，上赛季初客场逼平了另一场。随后在 2026 年 3 月的女足联赛杯决赛中以 2-0 获胜，并在该赛季最后一天以 1-0 获胜。

news.title: Alonso: 'We want to be able to win a boring game'
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：“我们希望能够赢得一场无聊的比赛”
news.body_en: While Xabi Alonso described our Carabao Cup victory over Leeds United as thrilling, the Chelsea manager is aware his side must be ‘able to win a boring game as well’. Five matches into the Spaniard’s tenure and no Blues supporter, be it those watching in the stands or following from home, can argue they have not been entertained. We have found the net on 16 occasions already this season, with the goals largely shared between Cole Palmer, Joao Pedro, Morgan Rogers and Danny Welbeck. The area of improvement is keeping them out at the other end. Leeds scored three at Stamford Bridge last night but were ultimately outgunned as the Blues advanced into the fourth round following a 6-3 victory. The Chelsea manager has been pleased with the attacking prowess of his side in our opening matches of the campaign, but acknowledges a better balance must be struck as the Blues continue to develop. ‘It’s early days to assess what we will be,’ Alonso said after our win over Leeds. ‘There are things, in terms of the connections of players and the associations, that I see are going to be important. ‘So we need to keep working on the good things and keep on improving other things. We want to have better balance, to be more solid, to be able to win in a boring game as well, if that happens. ‘But it's five games. For sure, we are now through [in the Carabao Cup] and we have two Premier League games before the international break. They are fundamental. ‘We want to finish well before the break and we have two tough games against Hull and Brentford.’ The first of those two fixtures comes on Saturday, as Hull City make the long trip down from Humberside to Stamford Bridge. And Alonso, whose name was repeatedly chanted by the Blues faithful against Leeds, has highlighted the crucial role our supporters will play once more this weekend. ‘We need them,’ he said. 'We need to create this connection, and we need to have a good feeling in this stadium.’
news.body_zh: 虽然哈维·阿隆索形容我们对利兹联队的联赛杯胜利令人兴奋，但切尔西主帅意识到他的球队必须“也能够赢得一场无聊的比赛”。西班牙人上任已经打了五场比赛，没有一个蓝军支持者，无论是在看台上观看的还是在家里观看比赛的人，都可以说他们没有得到娱乐。本赛季我们已经进球 16 次，进球大部分由科尔·帕尔默、若昂·佩德罗、摩根·罗杰斯和丹尼·维尔贝克共同进球。需要改进的地方是将它们排除在另一端之外。利兹联昨晚在斯坦福桥打进三球，但最终被蓝军以6-3获胜晋级第四轮。切尔西主教练对球队在本赛季首场比赛中的进攻能力感到满意，但他承认，随着蓝军的继续发展，必须取得更好的平衡。 “现在评估我们的目标还为时过早，”阿隆索在我们战胜利兹联后说道。 “就球员和协会之间的联系而言，我认为有些事情将会很重要。 “所以我们需要继续致力于好的事情，并不断改进其他事情。我们希望有更好的平衡，更稳定，能够在一场无聊的比赛中获胜，如果这种情况发生的话。 ‘但这是五场比赛。可以肯定的是，我们现在已经完成了[卡拉宝杯]，并且在国际比赛日之前我们还有两场英超比赛。它们是根本性的。 “我们希望在中场休息前早日结束比赛，我们将对阵赫尔城和布伦特福德，两场艰苦的比赛。”这两场比赛中的第一场将于周六举行，赫尔城将长途跋涉从亨伯赛德前往斯坦福桥。阿隆索的名字在对阵利兹联的比赛中被蓝军球迷反复高呼，他强调了我们的支持者将在本周末再次发挥的关键作用。 “我们需要他们，”他说。 “我们需要建立这种联系，我们需要在这个体育场有一种良好的感觉。”

news.title: Cole Palmer: You can see I’m enjoying my football!
news.title_zh: 科尔·帕尔默：你可以看到我很享受我的足球！
news.body_en: It didn’t take long for Cole Palmer to make an impact against Leeds having come off the bench ahead of the restart. Just ten minutes, in fact. Things hadn’t initially gone to plan following Xabi Alonso’s four half-time substitutions, with Leeds doubling their advantage through Brenden Aaronson. Enter Palmer. Our no.10 fired home a pinpoint penalty after Pep Chavarria was felled, and then barely 90 seconds later drew the Blues level at 2-2 with a clever, disguised finish. Fellow sub Pedro Neto completed the turnaround with another precise strike, making it three goals in seven breathless minutes, with the Blues eventually running out 6-3 victors. Palmer revealed what was said by Xabi Alonso in the dressing room at half-time, helping prompt the turnaround. ‘Up the intensity, play a bit more, come more alive because I think the first half was flat,’ said Palmer. ‘Everyone agreed in the changing room, so we stepped up. ‘I probably haven’t seen a half like that for a while. Leeds are a good team, tough game, but we needed to pull through and we did.’ The dramatic outcome continued our impressive start to the campaign. Palmer, meanwhile, has looked back to his best this season, playing with a swagger and making a decisive impact in the final third. He already has four goals, while collectively we have racked up 16 in just five matches. No wonder Palmer is a happy man right now. ‘You can see I’m enjoying my football,’ he said. 'Me and Morgz (Morgan Rogers), Joao (Pedro), all the attacking players, we’re enjoying it. ‘We’ve still got a bit to go. We’re getting results which is the main thing, and now it’s on to Hull on Saturday.’
news.body_zh: 没过多久，科尔·帕尔默就在对阵利兹联的比赛重新开始前替补出场，对球队产生了影响。事实上只有十分钟。在哈维·阿隆索四次半场换人后，事情最初并没有按计划进行，利兹联通过布伦登·阿伦森将优势扩大了一倍。帕尔默登场。在佩普·查瓦里亚被击倒后，我们的 10 号球员罚进了一个精准的点球，仅仅 90 秒后，凭借一记巧妙、隐蔽的射门，蓝军以 2-2 扳平了比分。替补球员佩德罗·内托再次精准射门，在令人窒息的七分钟内连进三球，最终蓝军以 6-3 获胜。帕尔默在中场休息时透露了哈维·阿隆索在更衣室里所说的话，帮助促成了逆转。 “提高强度，多打一点，变得更有活力，因为我认为上半场很平淡，”帕尔默说。 “更衣室里每个人都同意了，所以我们挺身而出。 “我可能有一段时间没见过这样的人了。利兹联是一支优秀的球队，比赛很艰难，但我们需要渡过难关，我们做到了。”戏剧性的结果延续了我们令人印象深刻的赛季开局。与此同时，帕尔默已经恢复了本赛季的最佳状态，他打球时神气十足，并在进攻三区发挥了决定性的作用。他已经打进了 4 个进球，而我们在短短 5 场比赛中总共打进了 16 个进球。难怪帕尔默现在是一个快乐的人。 “你可以看到我很享受我的足球，”他说。 “我和莫尔兹（摩根·罗杰斯）、若奥（佩德罗）以及所有进攻球员，我们都很享受。 ‘我们还有一段路要走。我们正在取得成果，这是最重要的，现在我们将在周六对阵赫尔城。”

news.title: Xabi Alonso on how belief was key to thrilling victory over Leeds
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索谈信仰如何成为战胜利兹联的关键
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso says his Chelsea players' belief and the Stamford Bridge crowd were crucial to the Blues claiming victory in our ‘thrilling’ Carabao Cup third-round tie against Leeds United. The opening period was far from easy for the Blues. With Alonso making nine changes to his starting XI, we struggled to get into a rhythm and fell behind midway through the half when Tarik Muharemovic headed home for Leeds. Alonso introduced Reece James, Pedro Neto, Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers at half-time; it was a decisive decision and one that paid off. Yet Leeds did first add to their lead, as Brenden Aaronson fired home two minutes after the restart. Then came the fightback. Palmer converted a penalty and quickly swept home a second to level the contest. Pedro Neto put us ahead with a fine finish, and Danny Welbeck added our fourth. Dominic Calvert-Lewin gave Leeds brief hope, but Valentin Barco's first Chelsea goal and a late Welbeck second extinguished any comeback. ‘It was thrilling and there were different emotions during the game,' reflected Alonso. 'Things were not going the way we wanted in the first half, and I made those decisions, so I take responsibility and take the blame, not the players. ‘In the second half, we showed a great reaction after conceding the second goal. We kept going, and it was very important to believe and get the crowd excited. They helped us a lot.' On his quadruple half-time substitution, Alonso added: '[We asked that] they try to have a good impact in energy, in aggressiveness, in tempo, in duels, because we were struggling in that moment against a very intense Leeds. We did very well. I take context for the first half and I will assess my own decisions. 'Even in the first half, I’m not going to blame the attitude. There were many new things together and they were not working – that is my responsibility. Afterward, once you score, you start believing, looking better and making better decisions. 'So it’s about the mind of the players, the feeling and it was much better in the second half.'
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索表示，他的切尔西球员的信念和斯坦福桥的球迷对于蓝军在卡拉宝杯第三轮对阵利兹联的“激动人心”的比赛中取得胜利至关重要。对于蓝军来说，开局阶段并不轻松。阿隆索对首发阵容做了九次调整，我们很难找到节奏，半场中段，塔里克·穆哈雷莫维奇头球回击利兹联时，我们落后了。阿隆索在中场休息时引进了里斯·詹姆斯、佩德罗·内托、科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯；这是一个果断的决定，并且得到了回报。然而利兹联队确实首先扩大了领先优势，布伦登·阿伦森在比赛重新开始两分钟后射门得分。然后是反击。帕尔默罚入点球，并迅速扳平比分。佩德罗·内托（Pedro Neto）以出色的成绩帮助我们取得领先，丹尼·维尔贝克（Danny Welbeck）为我们取得了第四个进球。多米尼克·卡尔弗特-勒温给利兹联带来了短暂的希望，但瓦伦丁·巴科在切尔西的第一个进球和维尔贝克后期的第二个进球浇灭了利兹联队的逆转。 “这很激动人心，比赛期间有不同的情绪，”阿隆索反映道。 “上半场事情并没有按照我们想要的方式发展，我做出了这些决定，所以我承担责任并承担责任，而不是球员。 “下半场，我们在丢第二个球后表现出了很好的反应。我们继续前进，相信并使观众兴奋非常重要。他们给了我们很多帮助。在半场四次换人时，阿隆索补充道：“[我们要求]他们试图在能量、侵略性、节奏、对决中产生良好的影响，因为我们在那一刻对阵非常激烈的利兹队时表现得很挣扎。”我们做得很好。我会了解上半场的背景，然后评估自己的决定。 “即使在上半场，我也不会责怪这种态度。有很多新的东西在一起，但它们不起作用——这是我的责任。之后，一旦你得分，你就会开始相信，看起来更好并做出更好的决定。 “所以这与球员的心态、感觉有关，下半场情况好多了。”

Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Eligible members can submit their application through the ticketing portal at any time during the window, supporters must ensure they are logged in to successfully apply. A maximum of four tickets can be bought per person, and only the ticket purchaser is required to be a member or season ticket holder. Club Chelsea tickets are non-refundable unless the match is cancelled, postponed, or moved more than 48 hours either side of the scheduled fixture date. All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to Club Chelsea terms and conditions. For any further Westview enquiries, please email clubchelsea@chelseafc.com. Supporters can access the ticket exchange through the Official Ticketing Portal. The sales information on the Buy Tickets page will be updated once the ticket exchange is open. The ticket exchange will close three hours before kick-off, unless stated otherwise. Those unsuccessful in the ticket application window will have a ticket exchange priority window. Once open, season ticket holders and members can send and receive tickets up until three hours before kick-off. news.title: Match report: Chelsea 6-3 Leeds United
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西 6-3 利兹联
news.body_en: An exhilarating second-half attacking performance saw the Blues score six goals to overcome and eliminate Leeds United and book a place in the Carabao Cup fourth round. The Blues fell behind in the opening period – Tarik Muharemovic heading in for the visitors – and appeared in danger of suffering an early exit when Brenden Aaronson drove home a second immediately after the restart. Yet our response to the adversity faced was emphatic. Two goals in two minutes from Cole Palmer, the first a penalty and the second a curled finish, brought us level, and Pedro Neto then put the Blues ahead with a well-taken strike. Alonso's side didn't relent. Welbeck struck a fourth and, while Dominic Calvert-Lewin temporarily reduced the deficit, Valentin Barco's first Chelsea goal and a second from Welbeck ensured our progress at the expense of our old rivals. In his pre-match press conference, Alonso said those who hadn't played many minutes this season would be given a chance to make their mark. The Blues head coach was true to his word, as nine changes were made to the team that started at Arsenal. Mike Penders started in goal behind a back three of Josh Acheampong, Maxence Lacroix and captain Levi Colwill. Malo Gusto and Pep Chavarria occupied the wing-back roles, 16-year-old Reggie Watson made his Chelsea debut in midfield alongside Barco, and Estevao Willian, Jamie Gittens and Danny Welbeck were in attack. Given the unfamiliarity of the starting XI, the Blues unsurprisingly took some time to settle into the game. Our best effort in the opening exchanges came from Gittens, who worked goalkeeper Michael Zetterer with an effort from distance. Leeds offered little threat until the 20-minute mark – then the visitors burst into life. Their first and second attempts on goal came in quick succession, and they brought out the best of Penders. A long throw into the Blues penalty area caused panic and the ball sat up for Aaronson. He was denied at close range by a fine stop from our Belgian goalkeeper, who then reacted instinctively to push over Muharemovic's follow-up header. However, it proved only a momentary reprieve as, after one corner was cleared behind, another Leeds delivery was met by Muharemovic at the back post, and he planted his header beyond Penders to put Leeds ahead. Leeds had momentum and looked to strike again soon after the restart. Another attack into the Blues' half ended with the ball falling to Sean Longstaff, who fired over from 18 yards. Our threat was limited during the remainder of the half. There were promising moments, such as an Estevao run that almost opened up a chance for Welbeck, an effort from Gittens deflected into the side netting, and a shot from Barco that bobbled wide, but it was a challenging half for Alonso's side. That perhaps informed the Spaniard's decision at the interval, as a quadruple substitution was made. Gusto, Watson, Estevao and Gittens were replaced. Reece James, Neto, Palmer and Rogers were introduced. It got worse for the Blues before it got better, as Leeds grabbed a second goal two minutes after the restart. It was a well-worked strike, as a low cross into the box was delicately flicked on by Lukas Nmecha and Aaronson drove home his finish. Two goals behind and facing an early cup exit, the Blues' resolve would be tested in the time that remained. Our route back into the game started with a penalty. Dan James fouled the crossing Chavarria and referee Jarred Gillett pointed to the spot. Palmer stepped up and rasped a shot into the corner. The noise inside Stamford Bridge increased. So did the tempo at which Alonso's side moved the ball. And two minutes after reducing the deficit, we levelled the contest. Palmer, again. It was a simple enough goal, as Rogers steered a long throw into the path of the Blues' No.10, who expertly guided a 20-yard finish into the corner. There was no let-up – and another attack soon followed. This time, Palmer was the provider as he guided a cross into the box for the onrushing James, whose clipped finish beat Zetterer but went the wrong side of the post. The turnaround was complete, though, on the hour mark. Palmer and Rogers were involved, as the former played a pass through to the latter, who on the slide guided the ball toward Neto. The Portuguese winger ran onto and measured his shot, which clipped the far post and nestled in the net. Still, Alonso's side pushed for more. Palmer had a low drive blocked, but our fourth goal quickly arrived. Welbeck this time on the score sheet as he collected a low cross, shifted the ball onto his right foot, evaded two challenges and fired between the legs of Zetterer. The Blues had breathing space – for ten minutes, at least. That was temporarily eroded when Calvert-Lewin drove home from inside the area and left Alonso's side facing a nervy finish. Leeds sensed there was a path to parity and committed players forward. Important blocks and defensive interventions were made; Alonso's side had to work again. Yet with ten minutes remaining, another powerful Rogers run and cross created our fifth. His delivery broke kindly to Barco, who slammed home his first Chelsea goal With that, our progress was sealed, although the scoring wasn't over. In the fourth of six added minutes, another attack ended with Barco skewing a shot toward goal, which Welbeck redirected into the corner to round off the evening. The Blues are back at Stamford Bridge on Saturday afternoon, as we take on Hull City in Premier League action. Kick-off is at 3pm (BST), and you can follow all the action on the Chelsea Official App and website. 分钟，利兹联才几乎没有带来任何威胁，随后客队开始活跃起来。他们的第一次和第二次射门很快就接连发生，他们发挥出了彭德斯的最佳水平。蓝军禁区的一记长传引起了恐慌，球落到了阿伦森手中。他在近距离被我们的比利时门将的精彩扑救挡出，随后比利时门将本能地做出反应，推开了穆哈雷莫维奇的后续头球。然而，这只是暂时的缓刑，在一个角球被清除后，利兹队的另一次传球被后门柱的穆哈雷莫维奇接住，他的头球越过了彭德斯，帮助利兹队领先。利兹联队势头强劲，希望在比赛重新开始后不久再次发起进攻。蓝军半场的另一次进攻以肖恩·朗斯塔夫 (Sean Longstaff) 18 码处射门高出而告终。在上半场剩下的时间里，我们的威胁有限。有一些充满希望的时刻，比如埃斯特沃的跑动几乎为维尔贝克创造了机会，吉滕斯的射门偏入边网，巴科的射门偏出，但这对阿隆索的球队来说是一个具有挑战性的半场。这或许影响了西班牙人在中场休息时的决定，因为他进行了四次换人。加斯托、沃森、埃斯特瓦奥和吉滕斯被替换。介绍了里斯·詹姆斯、内托、帕尔默和罗杰斯。蓝军的情况在好转之前变得更糟，利兹联在比赛重新开始两分钟后就取得了第二个进球。这是一次出色的射门，卢卡斯·恩梅查
