news.title: Alonso on team selection and Reggie Watson debut
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈球队选择和雷吉·沃森首次亮相
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has made nine changes tonight, including handing a debut to 16-year-old Reggie Watson, and the manager has explained his thinking behind his starting XI ahead of our Carabao Cup tie against Leeds. Alonso has altered his keeper, defence, midfield and attack for the round three fixture, which arrives between league games against Arsenal and Hull. His faith in his squad depth is one of the reasons why he has no qualms in doing so. ‘We have an intense first week of the calendar, few games, and all of them they are ready,’ said Alonso. ‘We need them to feel that they are an important part of the team and that anyone can play, and they have to be ready, so it's good from the start, and as well that players from the bench they can have a good impact as well. ‘We need a top team performance today against a very intense team as Leeds as they demand a lot, and hopefully we will have a good game.’ Watson impressed in pre-season and has been given his chance tonight in the heart of midfield, becoming the fourth-youngest player in our history in the process. Alonso explained what it is about the 16-year-old that has caught his eye since he arrived at the club. ‘He's one of those players that all the coaches like: responsible, very reliable, focused on the game. You see that he has a football background from family, so it's a great day for him. ‘I mentioned in the team talk that we have all been Reggie Watson one day, and hopefully he will enjoy it. ‘My advice to him is that he deserves to be there because of what he has shown, because of his football, because of his mentality during pre-season when he did really well. ‘We want to encourage the Academy as well, that they see the players have a chance in the first team.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索今晚做出了九项改变，包括将首秀让给了 16 岁的雷吉·沃森，而主教练在卡拉宝杯对阵利兹联之前解释了他对首发阵容的想法。阿隆索在第三轮比赛中改变了他的门将、防守、中场和进攻，这场比赛在对阵阿森纳和赫尔城的联赛之间进行。他对球队深度的信心是他毫不犹豫地这样做的原因之一。 “我们的第一周非常紧张，比赛很少，但所有比赛都已经准备好了，”阿隆索说。 “我们需要他们感觉到自己是球队的重要组成部分，任何人都可以参加比赛，他们必须做好准备，所以从一开始就很好，而且替补球员也可以产生良好的影响。 “今天我们需要在对阵利兹这样一支非常激烈的球队的比赛中发挥出顶级的表现，因为他们要求很高，希望我们能打出一场精彩的比赛。”沃森在季前赛中给人留下了深刻的印象，今晚在中场核心位置获得了机会，成为我们历史上第四年轻的球员。阿隆索解释了这位 16 岁球员自从来到俱乐部以来吸引他注意的地方。 “他是所有教练都喜欢的球员之一：负责任、非常可靠、专注于比赛。你看他有足球背景，所以这对他来说是美好的一天。 “我在球队谈话中提到，有一天我们都会成为雷吉·沃森，希望他会喜欢这一天。 `我对他的建议是，他应该在那里，因为他所表现出的表现，因为他的足球，因为他在季前赛中表现出色时的心态。 “我们也想鼓励青训学院，他们看到球员们有机会进入一线队。”

news.title: Who is Chelsea midfielder Reggie Watson, the teenager who starts against Leeds?
news.title_zh: 对阵利兹联首发的切尔西中场雷吉·沃森是谁？
news.body_en: Making his Chelsea debut in our Carabao Cup third-round tie against Leeds United, we profile Academy midfielder Reggie Watson. For those who tuned into our pre-season fixtures during our summer tour of Australia and Asia, Watson will not be an unknown. The teenager featured in games against Western Sydney Wanderers, Tottenham Hotspur, AC Milan and Johor Darul Ta'zim and showcased a quality and composure that belied his years. Watson, whose father Ben represented clubs such as Crystal Palace, Wigan Athletic, Watford and Nottingham Forest during his playing career, now has the opportunity to make his mark in competitive action for the Blues – and his debut comes at Stamford Bridge. And here's what you should know about our latest debutant... Watson, who featured regularly for our Under-18s last season while still a schoolboy, was born on 26 January, 2010.  He celebrated his 16th birthday earlier this year. Watson has been regularly used as a midfielder in our Academy sides and for the first team during our pre-season tour this summer. He is an intelligent and composed player in possession and an excellent set-piece taker. Watson joined the Blues from Crystal Palace during his Under-15 season. Despite being just 16 years old, Watson has featured twice for our Cobham Next Gen side this season. He scored on his debut at that level against Bournemouth, and also netted in our recent 5-4 victory over West Ham United. Watson has represented England at Under-15 and Under-16 levels. Watson has been handed the No.31 shirt for the first team this season.
news.body_zh: 我们将介绍青训营中场球员雷吉·沃森，这是他在卡拉宝杯第三轮对阵利兹联队的切尔西队首秀。对于那些在澳大利亚和亚洲夏季之旅中收看我们季前赛的人来说，沃森不会是个陌生的人。这位少年在对阵西悉尼流浪者队、托特纳姆热刺队、AC米兰队和柔佛达鲁尔塔齐姆队的比赛中出场，展现了与他的年龄不符的品质和冷静。沃森的父亲本在职业生涯中曾代表水晶宫、维冈竞技、沃特福德和诺丁汉森林等俱乐部效力，现在他有机会在蓝军的竞技比赛中留下自己的印记——他的处子秀是在斯坦福桥。以下是您应该了解的有关我们最新登场球员的信息……沃森出生于 2010 年 1 月 26 日，他在上个赛季还是一名学生时就经常为我们 18 岁以下青少年队出场。今年早些时候，他庆祝了自己的 16 岁生日。沃森经常在我们的青训营中担任中场球员，并在今年夏天的季前赛中为一线队效力。他是一名聪明、冷静的控球球员，也是一名出色的定位球主罚手。沃森在U-15赛季期间从水晶宫加盟蓝军。尽管只有 16 岁，沃森本赛季已经为我们的科巴姆下一代球队出场两次。他在对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中首次亮相，并在我们最近 5-4 战胜西汉姆联的比赛中攻入一球。沃森曾代表英格兰参加 15 岁以下和 16 岁以下级别的比赛。沃森本赛季获得了一线队的31号球衣。

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea line up vs Leeds
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西对阵利兹联的阵容
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has made nine changes to his Chelsea side for this evening's Carabao Cup third-round tie against Leeds United at Stamford Bridge. After navigating Luton Town in the last round, the Blues face Premier League opposition and an old foe for a place in the fourth round this evening. Goalkeeper Mike Penders comes in for Emi Martinez, behind what is expected to be a back three of Josh Acheampong, Maxence Lacroix and Levi Colwill, who Alonso has named as the Blues captain this evening. In the wide positions, Malo Gusto is set to be deployed off the right flank with Pep Chavarria on the opposite flank. Valentin Barco starts in midfield and is set to be partnered by 16-year-old Reggie Watson, who makes his Blues debut. Alonso has opted to rotate his entire frontline from our last outing against Arsenal. Estevao Willian and Jamie Gittens replace Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers, while Danny Welbeck – who scored in the last round against Luton Town – comes in for Joao Pedro. news.title: WNL Cup report: Swindon Town 1-2 Chelsea Women Under-18s
news.title_zh: WNL 杯赛报：斯温顿镇 1-2 切尔西 18 岁以下女子队
news.body_en: Chelsea Women Under-18s came from behind to secure a 2-1 victory away at Swindon Town in our second Women’s National League Cup group game. The Blues, who play in the PGA Under-21 Women's League, conceded inside the opening minute but responded strongly after the break, with Stevie Sinclair (pictured top) scoring twice to complete the comeback. The result keeps Chelsea top of Group D after two WNL Cup matches. Chelsea controlled possession from the start but were caught out when a central pass into midfield was turned over. Swindon won the first contact and transitioned quickly, with a diagonal pass finding their winger inside the Chelsea back line. The ball was struck first time with power, giving the hosts the lead after just one minute. The Blues had to work hard to defend Swindon's longer balls and adjust to a difficult surface, but remained in the contest as we looked to respond. Chelsea made three changes at the interval, with Annie Boichat, Stevie Sinclair and Chelsea N'Drin introduced for Sophie Leach, Tess Finn and Carla Gardiner. The changes helped the Blues produce a positive second-half performance, and we drew level after 64 minutes. Rebekah Pierce battled for possession after Chelsea regained the ball from a throw-in in the middle third, before receiving the ball from Elise Christian. Pierce turned outside her opponent and, after the Swindon defender went to ground, her effort from the left was palmed back into the six-yard box. Sinclair had positioned herself in the right area and reacted instinctively to finish first time. Chelsea continued to push forward and completed the turnaround with 13 minutes remaining. Pierce dropped deep to combine with Gabi Storey before playing the ball forward. N'Drin had moved into the left channel and drove at her defender before cutting inside. She then produced a well-weighted pass into the path of Sinclair on the edge of the box, with the midfielder using her left foot to lift the ball over the goalkeeper and complete her brace. The result means Chelsea sit top of Group D after two Women’s National League Cup group games. The Blues have enjoyed the challenge of playing and competing against Women's National League opposition, with this victory following our opening group-stage win. After a busy period of four games in 11 days, Chelsea return to PGA Under-21 Women's League action when we travel to Brighton on Wednesday 16 September. Some of the squad will also be away with their national teams during the international period. news.body_zh: 在第二场女子全国联赛杯小组赛中，切尔西 18 岁以下女子队后来居上，客场 2-1 战胜斯温顿镇。参加 PGA 21 岁以下女子联赛的蓝军​​在开场一分钟内就失球，但在中场休息后做出了强有力的回应，史蒂维·辛克莱 (Stevie Sinclair)（上图）梅开二度完成逆转。切尔西队在两场 WNL 杯比赛后以小组头名身份晋级。切尔西从一开始就控制了控球权，但在向中场的中路传球被失误时被抓住了。斯温顿赢得了第一次接触并迅速转变，斜传找到了切尔西后防线内的边锋。皮球第一次大力射门，仅一分钟后主队就取得了领先。蓝军必须努力防守斯温顿的长球并适应困难的场地，但在我们寻求回应时仍留在比赛中。切尔西在中场休息时做出了三项调整，用安妮·博伊查特、史蒂维·辛克莱和切尔西·恩德林换下索菲·利奇、泰丝·芬恩和卡拉·加德纳。这些改变帮助蓝军在下半场取得了积极的表现，我们在第64分钟后扳平了比分。切尔西在中场通过掷界外球夺回球权后，丽贝卡·皮尔斯 (Rebekah Pierce) 为控球权而战，然后从埃莉斯·克里斯蒂安 (Elise Christian) 手中接球。皮尔斯转向对手外侧，在斯温顿后卫倒地后，她从左侧的射门被掌回六码禁区内。辛克莱将自己定位在正确的区域，并本能地做出反应，第一次完成比赛。切尔西继续推进，在比赛还剩13分钟时完成逆转。皮尔斯回撤到后跟加比·斯托里结合，然后向前传球。恩德林已经进入了左路，在切入内线之前向防守球员发起进攻。然后，她在禁区边缘向辛克莱尔传出一记重磅传球，辛克莱尔用左脚将球举过门将，完成了梅开二度。这一结果意味着切尔西在两场女足全国联赛杯小组赛后排名 D 组榜首。蓝军很享受与女子国家联盟对手的比赛和竞争的挑战，在小组赛首场胜利后取得了这场胜利。经过 11 天内的四场比赛的繁忙时期后，切尔西将于 9 月 16 日星期三前往布莱顿，重返 PGA 21 岁以下女子联赛。部分队员还将在国际比赛期间随国家队出战。切尔西（4-3-3）：弗雷亚·维克斯； Elise Christian、Gabi Storey、Sophie Leach (Annie Boichat h/t)、Zoe Ciccardini； Belle Sullivan (c)、Keira Johnston、Tess Finn (Stevie Sinclair h/t)； Jahmya Putman（Rebekah Pierce 59）、Carla Gardiner（Chelsea N'Drin h/t）、Maisie Brickell。进球者：Sinclair 64, 77 预订：N'Drin 88 主教练：Leanne Champ 您可以在 9 月 20 日星期日在 Kingsmeadow 观看我们的切尔西女子学院队对阵阿森纳队的比赛，比赛时间为晚上 7 点 30 分。季票持有者、切尔西会员或任何 20 岁以下的支持者均可在 9 月 18 日星期五中午 12 点之前免费领取一张本场比赛的门票。完整的门票详情如下。
